name: code-bridge-mcp
description: A local, approval-first MCP bridge between web AI chats and VS Code.

scripts.validate:mcpb: npm run stage:mcpb && mcpb validate mcpb-build
scripts.package:mcpb: npm run validate:mcpb && mcpb pack mcpb-build code-bridge.mcpb && mcpb info code-bridge.mcpb
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --ext ts,json --ignore node_modules --exec tsx src/server.ts
scripts.test:transport: node --input-type=module -e "import { McpServer } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js'; import { WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.js'; const server = new McpServer({name:'transport-test',version:'1'}); const transport = new WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport({sessionIdGenerator:undefined,enableJsonResponse:true}); await server.connect(transport); const request = new Request('https://example.invalid/mcp',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json','accept':'application/json, text/event-stream'},body:JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:1,method:'initialize',params:{protocolVersion:'2025-03-26',capabilities:{},clientInfo:{name:'test',version:'1'}}})}); const response = await transport.handleRequest(request); if (response.status !== 200 || !response.headers.get('content-type')?.startsWith('application/json')) throw new Error('Expected a JSON Streamable HTTP response'); console.log('Transport test passed: application/json'); await transport.close();"
scripts.test: npm run test:transport && npm run test:security
scripts.package:extension: npm run build:extension && cd vscode-extension && node ../node_modules/@vscode/vsce/vsce package --out ../code-bridge-vscode.vsix --allow-missing-repository
